_about: A Composer project (nwn5e-ee #39): the VFX Bench's Composer edits it, tools/data/composer/build.js builds it (README.md there).
A spell mesh: each variant is a mesh for spells, n5m_<name>[_<k>] - a draft in the bench's vfxedit/saved, the chunk an emitter
throws or a mesh beat in an effect.
#39's Spiritual Weapon (the owner, 2026-11-23: "for these effects can I pick an existing weapon mesh instead of using a custom one?",
then "set it up and make 1 handed swords the first weapon, you can pick one at random"): shortsword 012 of the game's 99 one-handed
swords, drawn by a random draw; standing upright, point up, about 0.9 m, its texture Greyscale and tinted pale blue, added light and self-lit (Blend:
Additive). tools/data/spiritweapon/build.js turns it into the force's three effects at build time - nothing of the game's is kept here.
name: swpsword
